Exp - 6-12Yrs

Skill - Gen AI Engineer

Location - Pan India




Project Role Description : Act as software detectives, provide a dynamic service identifying and solving issues within multiple components of critical business systems.

Must have skills : Generative AI

Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Professional & Technical Skills:

- Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Generative AI.

- Experience with natural language processing techniques and machine learning model deployment.

- Strong analytical skills to diagnose complex system issues and develop effective solutions.

- Familiarity with cloud platforms and infrastructure supporting AI applications.

- Ability to work with large datasets and optimize AI model performance.

- Knowledge of software development lifecycle and incident management processes.




If interested, share your resume on alisha.k@anlage.co.in
